import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.PID
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Localization
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Integer
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.GaussLemma
#check_failure Roth.Θ_le_card
#check @Real.sSup_le
#check @csSup_le
#check @Set.forall_mem_image2
namespace ThetaLeCard189Isolated
universe u v
theorem law {s : Set ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ c) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : sSup s ≤ c :=
  Real.sSup_le hs hc
theorem family {A : Type u} {H : Type v} (f : A → H → ℝ) (s : Set A) (t : Set H)
    {c : ℝ} (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ h ∈ t, f a h ≤ c) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    sSup (Set.image2 f s t) ≤ c :=
  Real.sSup_le (Set.forall_mem_image2.mpr hf) hc
theorem nonempty_law {s : Set ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hs : s.Nonempty) (hb : ∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ c) :
    sSup s ≤ c := csSup_le hs hb
theorem empty_guard : ¬ (∀ (s : Set ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ c) → sSup s ≤ c) := by
  intro h
  have h' := h ∅ (-1) (by simp)
  rw [Real.sSup_empty] at h'
  norm_num at h'
theorem bdd_guard : ¬ (∀ s : Set ℝ, BddAbove s → sSup s ≤ 1) := by
  intro h
  have h' := h {2} (bddAbove_singleton (a := (2 : ℝ)))
  rw [csSup_singleton] at h'
  norm_num at h'
#print axioms law
#print axioms family
#print axioms nonempty_law
#print axioms empty_guard
#print axioms bdd_guard
end ThetaLeCard189Isolated
